sanitizer_groups.scope: The 598-case tac follow-up suite with ASan/UBSan.

asort.scope: Array sorting API; requires an adapter.

bashclock.scope: Different clock APIs; define clock and precision first.

bashinotify.scope: Event APIs differ; compare notification latency with an adapter.

bashio.scope: Descriptor API; compare the same offsets, sizes and sync policy.

bashjson.scope: Only overlapping JSON operations; strictness differs.

bashmount.scope: Mount namespace and filesystem fixture required.

bashpoll.scope: Persistent descriptor API; no equivalent applet CLI.

bashsyslogd.scope: Private socket and sink; include loss and throughput.

bignum.scope: Compare the same arithmetic operations and output base.

bsdgames.scope: Compare one matching game/algorithm at a time.

buf.scope: Persistent buffer API; benchmark editing operations.

caps.scope: Capability/query semantics need an isolated fixture.

claude.scope: Provider API client; separate response parsing from remote service latency.

clip.scope: Buffer clipboard API; compare copy/paste operations.

cluster.scope: Project membership protocol; define peer and failure scenarios.

coreutils.scope: Dispatcher with several commands; measure each subcommand.

cred.scope: Credential API with optional project kernel support.

dhcpd.scope: Private DHCP server exchange fixture needed.

dhcpd6.scope: Private DHCPv6 server exchange fixture needed.

dns.scope: Normalize DNS answers and control the resolver.

fail2ban.scope: Subset and private policy store; not a direct CLI drop-in.

fdflags.scope: Descriptor flag API; do not time an unrelated CLI.

fltexpr.scope: Define numeric precision and operation before comparing.

fw.scope: Backend-dependent firewall control; use a network namespace.

genl.scope: Generic netlink API; subsystem-specific fixtures needed.

gpu.scope: Persistent canvas/presenter; use frame and transport metrics.

hl.scope: Grammar/output differ; compare equivalent highlight spans.

http.scope: Match request, connection reuse and response body.

httpd.scope: Request/reply primitive; adapt server setup and connection policy.

index.scope: Git index API; compare equivalent index operations.

integrity.scope: Project integrity policy API; measure a defined verification workload.

ipcctl.scope: IPC API/subset; isolate objects and match the operation.

kitty.scope: Image/protocol bytes; not the whole terminal emulator.

ldap.scope: Use a controlled LDAP peer; parser time is separate.

lpr.scope: Current submit operation simulates printing; no comparable real print throughput.

mail.scope: Submission, queue and delivery are distinct workloads.

mlock.scope: Memory-locking API; control limits and faulting policy.

nano2.scope: Editor operation or scripted-key fixture; no shared CLI workload.

netids.scope: Rule subset and fixed capture; normalize alert content.

ns.scope: Namespace API; compare equivalent child setup.

ntp.scope: Controlled time server; never benchmark clock-changing operations on the host.

obj.scope: Git object API; match format and compression.

pack.scope: Git pack API; use fixed object sets.

payload.scope: Project payload manager; install/remove need an external helper.

pcap.scope: Packet capture API; use fixed captures or an isolated link.

pkg.scope: Project package format and repository policy.

pkt.scope: Packet encode/decode API; compare fixed packet formats.

procstat.program: iostat / mpstat / sar / pidstat / pmap / pldd
procstat.scope: Measure subcommands against fixed procfs data.

pty.scope: Persistent PTY API; startup and relay are separate operations.

rngseed.scope: Entropy-crediting policies differ; isolate kernel state.

rtspcat.scope: RTSP/RTP access-unit framing; controlled stream needed.

scrub.scope: Text redaction policy API, not a disk eraser.

signal.scope: Signal names and delivery APIs differ.

sqlite.scope: Persistent SQL handles; separate open/prepare/query costs.

tiv.scope: Image-to-terminal encoding; normalize dimensions and output mode.

toml.scope: Parser/query API; match queries and decoded values.

totp.scope: Fixed key/time/hash; never use account secrets in benchmarks.

tui.scope: Persistent cell UI API; measure changed cells and terminal traffic.

undo.scope: Buffer undo API; benchmark representative editing histories.

userdb.scope: Account lookup API; use controlled account databases.

utf8.scope: Codepoints and grapheme clusters are different workloads.

utmp.scope: UTMP record API; use private files.

vec.scope: Persistent vector API; match types, allocation and operation count.

vt.scope: Terminal parser/model API; compare state or rendered cells.

zlib.scope: Measure each codec and level with decoded-output checks.

acme.scope: Controlled ACME peer; separate crypto, protocol and remote issuance latency.

audit.scope: Kernel audit and record APIs; match rules and events in an isolated fixture.

auth.scope: Authentication policy API; use synthetic credentials and policy fixtures.

setpgid.scope: Process-group API; compare an owned child process.

sixel.scope: Image-to-Sixel encoder; compare the same pixels and terminal mode.

sv.scope: Supervisor API/subset; compare private service lifecycle operations.

cron.scope: Use a private schedule and job directory; measure scheduling delay and dispatch.

termpixel.scope: Terminal pixel canvas API; measure rendering and terminal bytes.

termpixel_pong.scope: Interactive graphics demo; frame time and terminal traffic are the useful metrics.

zstdcat.scope: Decompress fixed frames; verify output bytes before timing.

grep.note: Default build disables -P; the separate pcre loadable supplies PCRE2 operations. See the source build switch.

bc.note: User-defined functions and output bases are explicitly incomplete in addition to the repeat-input failure.

dmsetup.next: Define required mapper mutation verbs and add isolated device fixtures.

uclampset.note: Query subset; setting PID/system clamps and command mode are refused.
uclampset.next: Decide whether to implement the missing setter surface.

lpr.note: Submit copies into a spool and sleeps to simulate printing. No real printer throughput claim.

payload.note: Install/remove invoke a helper outside this repository; the current fixture only calls help.
payload.next: Add an installer-boundary fixture and document the external helper.

nano.note: Editor selftests pass; justify, spell and completion still report unimplemented.

pgrep.note: Matching is substring-based unless exact matching is selected; not full procps regular-expression behavior.

pkill.note: Shares pgrep matching and process traversal; validate signals only against owned child fixtures.

screen.note: Metadata/control fixtures pass; the live relay path needs separate sustained traffic measurements.

ssh.note: Host-key fixtures and loopback SSH interoperability pass; no transfer throughput measurements.

sshd.note: Loopback interoperability and malformed setup cases pass; no concurrent-session measurements.

sftp.note: Local operation and failure fixtures exist; remote transfer behavior needs dedicated interop and throughput coverage.

scp.note: Companion frontend to sftp; local-copy and failure fixtures do not establish full remote scp compatibility.

gpu.note: CPU/protocol, native driver and isolated Kilix checks exist. Static builds support CPU presentation; native shaders require dynamic linking.
gpu.next: Measure application frame latency and driver behavior on the intended device.

ldap.note: BER/filter fixtures and bounded fuzzing pass; live server/authentication throughput is unmeasured.

cluster.note: Only a version smoke check is mapped here.
cluster.next: Add peer membership, timeout and disconnect fixtures.

rtspcat.note: No command-specific fixture is mapped in the current repository suite.
rtspcat.next: Add a controlled RTSP/RTP stream with loss, reordering and framing checks.
